title: alopecurus bulbosus subsp. macrostachyos
intro: Alopecurus bulbosus subsp. macrostachyos, commonly known as the large-spiked meadow-grass, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating digestive issues and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and carminative properties. The bioactive constituents of Alopecurus bulbosus subsp. macrostachyos include various flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
